_meta.scenario: Fare dispute — customer refused to pay the remaining balance amount shown in the app after trip completion. Driver reported this to admin. Admin marks the trip as dispute and a dispute record is created for investigation. Balance payment is intentionally NOT zeroed out so the payment details remain visible for resolution.
_meta.note: Driver availability is freed even in dispute. Balance payment remains non-zero for audit purposes until dispute is resolved.

reason: Customer refused to pay remaining balance. Fare dispute raised by driver.

dispute_detail.reason: Customer disputed the final fare citing it was higher than quoted. Driver confirmed the meter reading was correct and extra charges were for a detour at customer request.
